name: Full Smile
verdict: The biggest movement is a 66.67% drop in leads over the last 7 days, which drove CPL up 168.88%, likely caused by Meta going dark (channel_dark:meta flag) and at least one zero-spend day disrupting delivery. Over 28 days, Meta generated 94 leads at a $7.40 CPL on $695.90 spend, while GHL recorded 92 opportunities created from 346 contacts, with 0 won.

performance.verdict: Meta dark 2 days kills volume; 5 overdue SOW items threaten renewal.

findings.text: Meta went dark Sep 12–13 (2 consecutive zero-spend days); leads dropped 66.67% WoW, pushing CPL from ~$7.40 to ~$19.85 in the 7d window.
5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: Jul 23 renewal doc; latest: Aug 31 dashboard + renewal decision) — none show a completed event.
GHL shows 92 opps created from 346 contacts, 0 won and 0 appointments — 94 Meta leads are not converting inside CRM, signaling an intake leak, not an ads problem.
3-day signal (Sep 11–13): leads = 0, spend = $37.85 → $0 → $0; vs prior 3 days (Sep 8–10): leads = 5, spend = $85.52 — confirmed delivery collapse, not a single bad day.
GBP actions fell 38.71% WoW and registered 0 on Sep 12–13, mirroring Meta dark days — organic signal is collateral, not an independent decline.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta delivery immediately — 2 zero-spend days confirmed; diagnose billing/policy hold before any budget change.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend hit $0 on Sep 12 and Sep 13, causing a confirmed 66.67% lead drop and CPL spike to ~$19.85 vs the 28-day baseline of $7.40. First action is to identify the cause — billing lapse, ad account flag, or policy hold — and restore delivery today. Success is confirmed when spend returns to the prior daily average of ~$27–$34 and leads resume within 48 hours. Re-check Sep 16.

suggestions.text: Fix CRM intake leak: 94 Meta leads produced 0 won opps and 0 appointments in GHL — tag and routing audit needed now.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 92 opportunities created from 346 contacts with 0 won and 0 appointments recorded against 94 Meta leads in the 28-day window. This is an intake routing or follow-up failure, not an ads problem. Audit lead-to-opp tagging, Lily's intake workflow, and the new hire onboarding status to confirm leads are being actioned. Success is at least 1 won opp or 1 confirmed appointment appearing in GHL within 7 days of fix.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP action recovery after Meta is restored; 38.71% WoW drop is likely collateral — re-check Sep 17.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 38.71% WoW and showed 0 on the same 2 days Meta went dark, suggesting the drop is collateral rather than an independent organic decline. No action is warranted until Meta delivery is confirmed restored. Re-check GBP 7-day trend on Sep 17; if actions remain below the prior 7-day baseline after Meta is live, escalate as a separate finding.
